items.q: What do I get on the free plan?
items.a: One connected inbox, forever, with no card. Your agent gets every MCP tool we ship against that mailbox: read, search, organise, label, draft, schedule and send. When you want a second mailbox on the same agent, that is Pro.

items.q: What counts as an MCP call?
items.a: A JSON-RPC tool invocation against your /mcp endpoint. We're a standard MCP server, so the same endpoint works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Windsurf, n8n, Make, and any MCP-compatible client. Plans are priced by connected inboxes, not by how many calls your agent makes.

items.q: Is my email content stored anywhere?
items.a: The email your agent reads is never stored: bodies, subjects, attachments, and thread content are fetched live from your provider and returned directly to the agent, with nothing persisted between calls. We store your encrypted OAuth token or app password so we can authenticate future requests. The one exception is a message you ask us to schedule for later. We store it until it is sent, and keep a record afterwards for your history.

items.q: What's the difference between Pro and Team?
items.a: Pro is one person with unlimited inboxes: every mailbox you own on a single agent, a 300 requests/minute ceiling, 90-day usage history, and email support. Team is for more than one person: unlimited members with roles, a separate workspace per client or business, SSO (SAML / OIDC), an audit log, 1-year history, and priority support.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
items.a: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel any time from the billing section of your dashboard. Cancelling stops the next renewal and you keep everything you paid for until the end of the current period, then drop to Free with one connected inbox. We don't refund partial periods, but see the refund question below for the first charge on a new subscription.

items.q: How does the annual discount work?
items.a: Paying annually saves about 20% versus monthly: Pro is $276 a year ($23 a month) and Team is $756 a year ($63 a month). You're charged once for 12 months upfront. Cancelling stops the renewal and you keep access until the year you paid for ends. Apart from the 14-day refund on a first charge, we don't refund the remaining months.

Gmail uses OAuth 2.0. Fastmail connects with an app password. iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, and Yandex connect with an app-specific password, and any other mailbox works through the generic IMAP / SMTP connector.

Yes. If the first charge on a new subscription isn't what you expected, email us within 14 days and we refund it in full. After that, you can cancel any time and keep access until the end of the period you've already paid for, but we don't refund partial periods. If you're a consumer in the EU or the UK, those same 14 days are your statutory right of withdrawal.

items.q: Can I self-host it instead of paying?
items.a: Yes. MCP Emails is open source under AGPL-3.0 and free to self-host. A docker-compose stack runs the same MCP server, with your mailbox credentials encrypted under a key only you hold. Self-host covers IMAP and SMTP mailboxes; Gmail and Outlook one-click OAuth, the dashboard, team features, and support stay on the paid plans.
